basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast from Malmö, Sweden, who enjoys exploring the latest gadgets and technology trends. My interests include photography, where I primarily use Nikon cameras, and I'm an avid fan of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure and Kings of Leon. I work as a freelance IT consultant, helping small businesses optimize their tech infrastructure. In my free time, I love attending live concerts and exploring new places in and around Europe. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility of working remotely, which allows me to manage my own schedule. I typically browse Reddit during the late afternoon and evening hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the IT field for over 5 years. My expertise lies in troubleshooting hardware and software issues, which I've honed through both formal education and practical experience in various consulting projects.
